Ethel Jiri died from throat cancer and was buried alongside her husband in Bikita – Mutenyami village. Jairos was buried in the Mutenyami Village in Bikita and the burial was attended by prominent people including the then Prime Minister of Zimbabwe, Robert Gabriel Mugabe.
